about_the_game:
The Slate Natural History Museum has been overrun with sentient plant life. To make matters worse, your father has gone missing deep within its walls. It’s up to you to save the day and find the root of this mystery! 

Overgrown! is a 2.5D Action RPG about plants and family set in an overgrown Natural History Museum. You play as Lily, an aspiring botanist who’s trying to find her father, encountering newly sentient friends and foes throughout her journey. Along the way, she uncovers why her father returned to the museum, and what is bringing all the exhibits to life.

In this demo, defeat the fungal enemies that stand in your way with a branching combat system that caters to many different playstyles. Ally yourself with the shopkeeper Goldbloom, the mysterious Knights of the Porcelain Throne, and the gentle Baobab to assist them to unlock boons and artifacts that power up Lily’s skill set. Discover the history of the museum and its Zoology and Marine Biology exhibits and fill Lily’s journal with your findings and observations.
